estimation: NB2 maximum likelihood (scipy L-BFGS-B, SE from numerical Hessian); offset ln L + ln Y, Y = 3; overdispersion per mile, applied as k_seg = k/L (HSM Part C segment convention); site-type specs selected by AIC (≤ 1 covariate per 10 crashes)
eb: E = w·μ_Y + (1−w)·N, w = 1/(1 + (k/L)·μ_Y), μ_Y = SPF crashes over the Y-year period

overdispersion.explanation: The old outcome round(9·SUM_CRASH_) is (i) a ×9-scaled, injury-weighted ped/bike score, not a count — scaling a Poisson count by c multiplies its variance/mean ratio by c, which NB absorbs as spurious overdispersion (compare cris_count_times_9 with cris_count_pooled) — and (ii) a ped/bike outcome whose exposure is urban activity, not AADT: pooling rural FM roads (≈0 crashes at any AADT) with urban arterials leaves large unexplained heterogeneity (compare _plus_urban). Site-type SPFs remove (ii).

crash_field.conclusion: Pedestrian/cyclist injury-weighted crash score for 2021-2023 (≈0.9 per K/A/B crash, ≈0 per C/O crash); not an all-crash count, not a 9-year annual mean, not crashes per mile per year. Not used as the SPF outcome; kept as satp_crash_score.
